description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Text class, which models a text node in the parse tree used by the Smarty template engine. It includes methods for managing text data and whether the text should be stripped during output.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Text
classes.description: Represents a text node within the Smarty template parser's parse tree, with functionality to store text data and whether to strip it during output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a text node with given data and stripping flag.

methods.name: isToBeStripped
methods.description: Returns whether this text section should be stripped during output.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Returns the stored text data when generating Smarty PHP code.
